name: Alfa Romeo Giulia
license: Non-commercial use as part of this project; no standalone redistribution.
method: Sealed vertical envelope voxelized from the detailed vehicle mesh.

flow.method: Finite-volume Laplace potential, impermeable voxel boundary and slip ground; two linear basis solutions for yaw.

preparation: Connected surfaces extracted from existing geometry; matching material primitives combined. Degenerate triangles removed by Draco compression.
